name: webhookshield
scope_distinction: focuses on HTTP event delivery identifiers, nonce replay detection, and signed request bodies; it is not a network tunnel or general peer session protocol.

name: mailguard
scope_distinction: models MIME-like message metadata and per-message attachments; it is not clinical messaging or matter-scoped legal document exchange.

name: sessionexchange
scope_distinction: models application-level client/server suite negotiation and transcript binding; it does not establish a gateway tunnel or protect telemetry.

name: dataprovenance
scope_distinction: tracks general dataset/object lineage through chained digest checkpoints; it does not attest software builds or release artifacts.

name: desktopupdateproof
scope_distinction: verifies desktop-client product/platform release manifests and downgrade policy; it is separate from staged firmware fleet rollout.

name: packagemirror
scope_distinction: verifies mirrored package-index entries and package version monotonicity; it does not attest build workers or software release provenance.

name: approvalflow
scope_distinction: implements multi-approver request-stage quorums; it is distinct from delegated policy-bundle approval and authorization decisions.

name: clinicalconsent
scope_distinction: stores synthetic subject-scoped permissions with cryptographically verified revocation; it does not exchange clinical messages.

name: fleetpermit
scope_distinction: issues portable vehicle permits for offline signature and validity checks; it is unrelated to device enrollment or firmware delivery.
